name: @cocreate/clipboard
description: A simple clipboard component in vanilla javascript. Easily configured using HTML5 data-attributes and/or JavaScript API.
author: CoCreate LLC

binding.actionsIntegration: When an element has an actions attribute, direct click handling is skipped.

attributes.name: clipboard
attributes.role: Copies the element's own value when used as a declarative control; also reflects the current operation state.

attributes.name: clipboard-query
attributes.role: Selects source elements relative to the control using CoCreate queryElements with the clipboard prefix.

actions.name: clipboard
actions.description: Copies the value of the action element or the elements selected by its clipboard-query attribute.
actions.failure: Aborts the action chain with the copy error.

valueHandling.blob: Copied using its MIME type, or application/octet-stream when the type is empty.
valueHandling.undefined: Ignored; if no valid ClipboardItems remain, the operation fails.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes matching elements. With no argument, scans the document; accepts an element, collection, NodeList, or array.

methods.name: clipboard
methods.description: Copies values from the supplied source elements to the system clipboard and returns a promise for the result.

events.name: clipboarded
events.description: Bubbles after a successful copy; detail contains clipboardItems.

events.name: clipboard-error
events.description: Bubbles when copying fails; detail contains the error.

constraints: Direct click handling skips disabled controls and controls with aria-disabled="true".
Copying requires browser support for navigator.clipboard.write and ClipboardItem, plus the browser's applicable clipboard permissions and context requirements.
